newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Properties '96 net 1.4 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Properties '96 net 1.4 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen Properties & Resources Development (Group) Ltd registered net profits of 1.37 million yuan for 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.0025 yuan and turnover reached 969.98 million in 1996, the exchange said.
It did not say whether the figures were based on Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
In 1995, the company posted net profits of 214.99 million yuan under Chinese standards.
The company has proposed no dividend for 1996, the exchange said.
Trading in the firm's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
